headline: EPS dips sequentially but jumps year-over-year
summary_short: Samyang Foods reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ₩18,216, down 5.1% q/q from ₩19,198 but up 60.7% y/y from ₩11,335.
summary_long: EPS of ₩18,216 fell 5.1% sequentially from ₩19,198 but rose 60.7% year-over-year from ₩11,335. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
